_note: Tier 2, oldest end. Mid to late November 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Comparing an image on screen to what he saw, he confirms the figures were arranged in a V, cloaked, looking down, with their eyes not visible.
mentions.quote: It was at a V. And it was cloaked over and they were looking down
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: he is matching an image on screen to a figure he saw, with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: He describes Jesus moving through the villages of Europe knocking on the doors of unbelievers' hearts, with a line of people forming behind him that keeps getting longer.
mentions.quote: I SEE JESUS MOVING THROUGHOUT EUROPE. HE'S MOVING THROUGHOUT THE VILLAGES
mentions.falsify_match: A visible religious awakening across European villages.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told three times that the time is late, and says the same movement goes through South America and on to Australia.
mentions.quote: He said the TIME IS LATE. THE TIME IS LATE
mentions.falsify_match: Revival spreading across South America and Australia.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The time is late carries no date and has been said across the corpus since 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He describes European cottages with hinges broken off doors and windows and shingles missing from roofs, with Jesus knocking and marching through Europe.
mentions.quote: hinges are all broken off of their doors
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: symbolic disrepair in a vision with no worldly referent.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the people in the vision wearing brown shorts with overalls and nice shirts, and getting into the line.
mentions.quote: they're wearing brown shorts with overalls
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: costume detail inside the vision.

mentions.claim_text: A family member supplies the word lederhosen for the clothing he is describing, and he continues with a chubby boy with brown hair running up.
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: the identifying word is supplied to him by someone in the room, which places the vision in Bavaria after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is shown flowers in the green grass turning toward Jesus and bowing down as he walks the path in Europe.
mentions.quote: the flowers are turning toward him and they're bowing down
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: devotional imagery with no worldly referent.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking prophetically he pronounces woe to Miami twice, then says it shot out to California and Los Angeles like lightning.
mentions.falsify_match: A disaster or judgment event at Miami, then Los Angeles.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Woe carries no content, so any misfortune in either city would be claimable.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of a day of sternness and shaking, repeats that within 24 hours everything will change and nothing known will be the same, and says he sees a storm coming in New York with lightning.
mentions.falsify_match: A single day transforming the American situation, with a storm over New York.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The 24-hour frame still has no start date attached, which is the fourth telling of it on file.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a lightning bolt and a storm inside Manhattan, everything changing, and a great storm running down the east coast from New York to Miami with a glorious light over it.
mentions.quote: there's a lightning bolt and a storm inside of Manhattan
mentions.falsify_match: A major storm running the eastern seaboard from New York to Miami.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated. Storm is left between weather and metaphor, as elsewhere in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing the Pilgrims at Plymouth Rock praying, taking communion and dedicating the land of America as one nation that would fear God, and echoes that dedication over the property they are on.
mentions.quote: they dedicated the land of America as one nation
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a historical scene, recounted. Note the Mayflower Compact was signed aboard ship and the Plymouth Rock association is a later tradition.

mentions.claim_text: He says God gave a man supernatural strength to finish the battle knowing that he and his wife would be standing there praying for America today, and notes over a hundred people were saved through the last video.
mentions.quote: we had over 100 people get saved this last video
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a count of professions of faith reported from the previous stream.

mentions.claim_text: He says those founding prayers still stand before the Father, reports being told America will not be a goat nation but a sheep nation, and says a great shaking to awaken is coming to the land.
mentions.quote: You will not be a goat nation. You will be a sheep nation
mentions.falsify_match: America ending on the sheep side of the division he describes at the UN.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The sorting is an eschatological judgment with no observable marker before the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed him the time frame thousand years by thousand years, played before his eyes like a film, and that he described it as best he could.
mentions.quote: he went from each thousand years and he played it before my eyes
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a survey of history shown in vision, with no dated claim extracted from it.

mentions.claim_text: He says all of humanity has come to the wire and that the days are getting darker with artificial babies and manipulation, as in the days of the Nephilim when angels lay with women and produced giants.
mentions.quote: as the days of the Nephilim, the angels lying with the women
mentions.falsify_match: Genetic engineering of humans reaching a scale he would identify as the days of Noah.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. No threshold is given, and reproductive technology is already widespread, so the bar can be read as already met.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was shown the Chinese empire and the Great Wall being constructed in front of him, as part of what the Lord was showing him about time.
mentions.quote: the Great Wall of China and it was all being constructed
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a historical scene shown in vision.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the president be protected, live long and finish strong, and that he could eat or drink any deadly thing without harm, and that America be one nation under God.
mentions.quote: he'll eat any deadly thing and it will not harm him
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a protection petition drawn from Mark 16.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Mexico's president, asking that a godly leader be put in, and says he saw the cartels paying this woman off from Venezuela, along with MS-13 and the corruption.
mentions.quote: the cartels that I saw paying this woman off from Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence that Mexico's president is paid by cartels funded from Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such evidence. This is a corruption allegation against a named serving head of state, offered on the strength of the vision alone.
